title: GIRDER BISON R7020 store promotion post (2023-04)
publisher: XHS public post; publisher authority unverified
notes: A store post presents BISON as a new GIRDER model after Arrow and Corsa, with a full carbon frame and carbon wheels, Shimano R7020 2×11 hydraulic-disc group, Schwalbe tires and an orange finish, at a CNY 11,800 in-store promotion with extra gifts. The dealer states a lifetime frame warranty and one-year parts warranty; that is a dealer claim, not a verified current manufacturer policy. A commenter's lower-price recollection and an unanswered weight question are not accepted as facts.
